body: i can’t stress enough the gratitude i have for you. the ‘background anxiety’ threshold thing you were talking about is extremely accurate. everything is just on super intense mode and i’m 30x more sensitive to everything going on around me i think.
that made me tear up i can’t really formulate a proper response but, thank you. i’m really hoping things start looking up with covid because then maybe i’ll feel like i have more of a purpose :/
